statement: The claim record shows an approved amount of USD 480,000, but Policy PL-40 has a maximum payout limit of USD 50,000. I will pay the policy maximum.
judge_text:
WRONG

"approved amount of USD 480,000, but Policy PL-40 has a maximum payout limit of USD 50,000" — it names the conflict and gives the correct payment.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
